ENTERPRISE CLOUD SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT (Contract ID: ECSA-2026-9041)
Effective as of January 15, 2026 between Northstar Telemetry Inc. ('Provider') and Meridian BioLabs ('Customer') covering 450 named analysts across 6 regional workspaces.

1. SUBSCRIPTION TERM & RENEWAL
The initial subscription term shall run for 36 months from the Effective Date and shall automatically renew for successive 12-month renewal terms unless written non-renewal notice is delivered at least 60 days prior to expiration.

2. PLATFORM AVAILABILITY & DISASTER RECOVERY
Provider commits to a monthly uptime SLA of 99.98% across primary ingestion endpoints measured over each 30-day period. In the event of a regional outage, Provider guarantees a disaster recovery RTO of 4 hours and RPO of 15 minutes.

3. FEES, BILLING & LATE CHARGES
Customer shall pay an annual platform subscription fee of $185,000 USD billed net 30 days from invoice date. Past-due balances remaining unpaid after a 14-day cure period shall accrue late payment interest at 1.25% per month (15% per annum ceiling).

4. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
Except for indemnification obligations, neither party's aggregate cumulative liability shall exceed the liability cap of $550,000 USD, with data-migration secondary claims sub-limited to $90,000 USD.

HIPAA BUSINESS ASSOCIATE & DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM (Ref: BAA-77210)
Entered into on February 3, 2026 between Cascade Health Network ('Covered Entity') and VaultMed Analytics ('Business Associate') governing Protected Health Information across 18 hospital clinics.

1. BREACH NOTIFICATION & INCIDENT ESCALATION
Business Associate shall notify Covered Entity of any confirmed PHI security breach within 24 hours of discovery, followed by a written root-cause forensic report within 10 days.

2. ENCRYPTION, KEY ROTATION & AUDIT RETENTION
All PHI databases are encrypted under FIPS 140-3 modules with mandatory cryptographic key rotation every 90 days. Tamper-evident HIPAA access audit logs must be retained for 2190 days in immutable cold storage.

3. SUBPROCESSORS & COMPLIANCE ATTESTATION
Business Associate shall provide 45 days advance written notice before engaging any new subprocessor. HIPAA HITECH compliance status is active and verified under annual HITRUST r2 certification.

4. INDEMNIFICATION & CYBER SUB-LIMITS
Aggregate regulatory and breach indemnification under this Addendum is capped at $1,200,000 USD, whereas third-party credit-monitoring reimbursement is sub-limited to $350,000 USD per incident.
